scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@sanaaai/types && npm run build --workspace=@sanaaai/config && npm run build --workspace=@sanaaai/db && npm run build --workspace=@sanaaai/providers && npm run build --workspace=@sanaaai/generation
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run start:dev --workspace=@sanaaai/api" "npm run start:dev --workspace=@sanaaai/worker" "npm run dev --workspace=@sanaaai/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run start:dev --workspace=@sanaaai/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run start:dev --workspace=@sanaaai/worker
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@sanaaai/web
scripts.db:init: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:role && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspace=@sanaaai/types && npm run test --workspace=@sanaaai/providers && npm run test --workspace=@sanaaai/api && npm run test --workspace=@sanaaai/worker && npm run test:e2e --workspace=@sanaaai/api && npm run test:e2e --workspace=@sanaaai/worker
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@sanaaai/api && npm run lint --workspace=@sanaaai/worker && npm run lint --workspace=@sanaaai/web
